# Test fixtures

`CA.jpg`, `XCA.jpg`, `no_manifest.jpg` were downloaded unmodified from the official Content Authenticity Initiative Rust SDK test fixtures:
https://github.com/contentauth/c2pa-rs/tree/main/sdk/tests/fixtures

These files accompany the MIT OR Apache-2.0 SDK and are used only for local testing, not published by this private bundle. `CA` is an embedded-manifest sample, `XCA` is a deliberately corrupted hard-binding validation case, `no_manifest` is unsigned. They are NOT ground-truth AI versus human classifier benchmarks. Public distribution of this test directory has not been requested; review any asset-specific upstream notices before redistribution.
